payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics and results related to gender bias amplification in language generation models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

claims.text: The bias amplification metric is computed for all models to study the effect of amplifying potential bias in text.
Fair Regions is the most effective method to mitigate bias amplification, showing a reduction of +0.09 compared to Seq2Seq and Seq2Seq+Attention which amplify bias by +0.18 and +0.25 respectively.
The study indicates that training encoders with news articles from different countries affects bias amplification, with Peru showing larger amplification than Mexico.
